name: bao-moi-backend
description: Backend services for Bao Moi application

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd services/api-gateway && npm install && cd ../auth-service && npm install && cd ../categories-service && npm install && cd ../comments-service && npm install && cd ../posts-service && npm install && cd ../tags-service && npm install
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:categories" "npm run start:comments" "npm run start:posts" "npm run start:tags" --names GATEWAY,AUTH,CATEGORIES,COMMENTS,POSTS,TAGS --prefix-colors white,white,black,white,black,white --prefix "[{name}]" --timestamp-format "HH:mm:ss"
scripts.migrate:all: concurrently "cd services/auth-service && npm run migrate:up" "cd services/categories-service && npm run migrate:up" "cd services/comments-service && npm run migrate:up" "cd services/posts-service && npm run migrate:up" "cd services/tags-service && npm run migrate:up"
scripts.clean:ports: node -e "require('child_process').exec('netstat -ano | findstr :300', (err, stdout) => { const processes = stdout.split('\n').filter(line => line.includes('LISTENING')).map(line => line.trim().split(/\s+/).pop()); processes.forEach(pid => { if (pid) require('child_process').execSync(`taskkill /F /PID ${pid}`); }); });"
